items.title: Football: Lobos slip, stumble and survive in Hawaii
items.summary:
New Mexico took the dreary route to victory on a rainy Saturday night, stumbling over enough self-inflicted wounds to make the finish far more stressful than necessary.

The Lobos had a tale of two halves in Honolulu, earning an ugly 21-10 win over the Rainbow Warriors, moving to 5-1 on the year and 2-0 in conference play for the first time since 1997.

"Undisciplined."

Just one of many words Head Coach Jason Eck used to describe New Mexico's uninspiring first-half performance. The offense managed just 108 total yards, but UNM's biggest issue was penalties: 12 that cost them
